name: 会話の文字書式を選ぶ操作バー
prompt:
Render a faithful 390×39 px image crop of the supplied Slack formatting toolbar. The native preview is the exact authority for the localized text and composition; the screenshot crop supplies toolbar context only. Preserve the full-width white background and faint horizontal divider at y=8. Keep one compact horizontal row in this exact order and native x positions: 反応 (x=10), 宛先 (47), 太字 (84), 斜体 (121), 取消 (158), リンク (195), 箇条書き (240), 番号 (297), 字下げ (334). Use Meiryo, 12 px, 16 px line-height, 0 letter spacing; neutral labels are #6E6E6E. Match the native crop and its lower clipping exactly, without adding vertical padding or a second row.

The third control, 太字, is selected: retain its pale mint #ECFDF5 background and bold dark green #047857 text. All other control surfaces stay white. リンク is the toolbar command to insert/edit a link, not linked content: the native text style has no link target and the reference chain icon is gray. Keep this command neutral gray; there is no hyperlink text in this toolbar to color blue. Do not add icons or any labels absent from the native preview. Preserve exact Japanese copy, spacing, alignment, and the 10:1 aspect ratio. Output only the toolbar crop on white.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
